# Financial Times

> > The Financial Times provides global business news, analysis, and insights on markets, economics, politics, and innovation, alongside exclusive events and investor briefings.

FT.com serves as the digital hub for the Financial Times, offering comprehensive coverage of global finance, economics, and business strategy. The platform connects business leaders, investors, and decision-makers through premium journalism, live events, and specialized briefings on topics ranging from energy transition and AI investment to capital allocation and sustainable growth.

## Key Topics

- Energy transition
- Capital allocation
- AI investment
- Digital infrastructure
- Financial innovation
- Global economy
- Davos and World Economic Forum
- Qatar Investment Authority
- Investor briefings
- Sustainable growth
- Middle East commodities
- Brand strategy and creativity
- Subscription services
- Customer support

## FT Live Events and Briefings

- [Capital and Innovation in a Changing World 2026](https://innovativechangingworld.live.ft.com/): FT briefing on capital allocation, AI, and sustainable global economy
- [Commodities Middle East Summit 2026](https://commoditiesmiddleeast.live.ft.com/): FT Live summit on Middle East commodities, energy, and trade leadership
- [FT Sessions at Cannes Lions 2026](https://ftsessionscannes.live.ft.com/): FT event at Cannes Lions for marketers and brand leaders on creativity

## Support and Help

- [Help Centre](https://help.ft.com/): FT subscription FAQs and support for Print, Digital, and combined plans

## Optional

- [The $7tn communication crisis: Why every business needs to go visual](https://canva.ft.com/): Canva-sponsored article on visual communication crisis in business
